description: A fearless agent races across the city to stop a weapons deal before an explosion destroys the harbor.
A former soldier rescues hostages from a skyscraper controlled by a violent criminal gang.
A martial arts champion fights through a criminal fortress to rescue his kidnapped brother.
A chase across rooftops, highways, and tunnels pushes a spy team toward a final explosive showdown.
A police officer battles mercenaries after a convoy ambush turns the city into a war zone.
Two clumsy roommates start a fake business and accidentally become famous after a series of hilarious mistakes.
A small-town baker enters a television contest and creates chaos with jokes, romance, and spilled frosting.
An awkward teacher pretends to be a celebrity chef and causes a dinner party full of comic disasters.
A group of friends plan a simple vacation that collapses into pranks, misunderstandings, and absurd surprises.
A failing actor joins a corporate training video and accidentally becomes the office prank hero.
A grieving father reconnects with his daughter while facing memories of a painful family secret.
An ambitious musician struggles with love, sacrifice, and the cost of chasing success in a lonely city.
A judge returns to her hometown and confronts old wounds, family loyalty, and a difficult moral choice.
A young student cares for his sick mother while trying to escape poverty through education.
Three siblings reunite after years apart and uncover the emotional truth behind their father's silence.
A group of friends spend the night in an abandoned mansion where whispers reveal a terrifying curse.
A nurse working the night shift discovers that the hospital basement hides a supernatural presence.
A haunted mirror releases a vengeful spirit that stalks a family through nightmares and shadows.
Campers in a remote forest hear screams at midnight and discover an ancient monster beneath the lake.
A priest investigates a possession after a child's room fills with insects, voices, and chilling visions.
Two strangers meet on a delayed train and fall in love while sharing stories about their dreams.
A chef and a travel writer rediscover hope and affection during a summer in a seaside village.
Childhood friends reconnect at a wedding and realize their old letters still carry unfinished love.
A bookstore owner and a photographer build a tender relationship while saving a historic neighborhood shop.
A pianist falls for a dancer during rehearsals, and their love grows through music and forgiveness.
Astronauts travel through a wormhole and encounter an alien signal that could change humanity forever.
In a future ruled by machines, a young engineer builds a robot that learns the meaning of freedom.
Scientists awaken on a distant planet where clones, artificial intelligence, and time loops threaten survival.
A spaceship crew discovers a black hole experiment that opens portals to parallel universes.
A rebel hacker fights a virtual reality empire after learning that memories can be programmed.
A journalist uncovers a conspiracy and must escape a dangerous assassin before publishing the truth.
A detective follows coded clues from a serial killer while the city waits in fear.
A woman receives anonymous threats and realizes her neighbor may be part of a deadly cover-up.
A banker trapped in a surveillance plot races to expose blackmail before his family disappears.
An undercover witness hides in a motel while rival agents hunt for a stolen government file.
